campaign.title: M1 D=1 centered nonzero theta-matrix gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Audit primary fixed-modulus incomplete quadratic-root, theta-multiplier Kloosterman bilinear, quadratic large-sieve, dispersion, and half-integral spectral theorems only against the literal nonzero matrix. Record modulus and averaging variables, coefficient class, zero-frequency exclusions, all spectral pieces, fold and endpoint hypotheses, and every restored N-M-V-d power.

frozen_target.question: Can the exact incomplete nonzero theta matrix be proved target-sized through its centered physical quadratic-root discrepancy, a mask-preserving joint j-v transform, or an equivalent selected cross-fibre theorem; if not, what is the first exact mixed-variation, fold, diagonal, source, endpoint, or restored-power obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Fix A>0, q=4N, J_A=M^(3/4)(log(2X))^A, K=sqrt(NM), and J_A<V<=K. For each odd d|N put c=4N/d and H=c/2. The frozen matrix is -i(1+i)/(2Nq) sum_(V<|j|<=2V) sum_(d|N,d odd) chi_4(d)d sqrt(c) sum_(v mod H,v!=0) Bhat_j(2dv)K(-v^2,-j;c). Equivalently, with G_N(t)=1_(N|t)chi_4(t/N), A_j=Bhat_j(0), and B_j^circ(x)=B_j(x)-A_j/(4N), it is sum_j sum_(x mod 4N) B_j^circ(x)G_N(x^2-j).
quantities: Retain arbitrary N, every odd d|N, c=4N/d, H=c/2, all nonzero representatives, complementary modes, and every 2N/d fold.
Retain both defect signs, the exact ambient residual phase, literal zero-extended profile, asymmetric cell, strict mask, transitions, hard endpoints, and external B_(1,U)(1) seam.
Independently prove the centered physical identity and charge the global constant tail in B_j^circ.
Derive the exact mixed j-x variation or rectangular decomposition before invoking a discrepancy norm.
If K is opened, keep Bhat_j(2dv) coupled to j and v and restore the full selector, Fourier, d sqrt(c), modulus, and outer-sum normalization.

Complete v-resummation, the closed zero row, termwise DFI, physical-diagonal-only Parseval, bare reciprocal-arc localization, fixed-v bounds followed by absolute v-summation, and the hypothetical V<=M^(3/2) capacity are frozen as gains.
A source theorem must match the fixed modulus, theta multiplier, nonzero frequency, coefficient class, averaging variables, spectral pieces, folds, signs, and endpoints.
Every norm and theorem right side is an upper capacity until all N-M-V-d powers are restored.
No result transfers to D>1, L>1, generic t=1, t>=2, cross, M2, endpoint uniformity, M9, bridge, target, or exponent owners.

Close under exactly one label: outer_defect_nonzero_matrix_target, strict_outer_defect_nonzero_matrix_range, or outer_defect_centered_discrepancy_no_go.
